title.ban: **A ban on your record in {server} was removed**
title.kick: **A kick on your record in {server} was removed**
title.mute: **A mute on your record in {server} was removed**
title.warn: **A warn on your record in {server} was removed**
title.generic: **A {type} on your record in {server} was removed**

voided.mistake: Staff removed it as a mistake. It no longer counts against you.

uncounted.automod: Automod warning. It doesn't count toward bans
uncounted.ladderOff: Warning. It doesn't count toward bans (warn ladder off)

dm.body: You have been quarantined in **{server}** for **{reason}**.

alert.title: Member quarantined
alert.ping: **{name}** was quarantined. Please take a look.
alert.rolesKept: Roles that stay (managed by Discord or an integration)
alert.dmFailed: Not delivered (DMs closed or no shared server)
alert.channelsOpenValue: {count} channel(s) refused Mewvo's overwrite (no Manage Permissions there): they may still see those.

trigger.raid: Raid lockdown: a raid joiner broke an automod rule
trigger.automod: Automod: a ban-level offence (quarantined instead of the ban)

log.skipped: Saved roles not given back (gone, managed or above Mewvo)
log.left: None: they are no longer in the server

refuse.noRole: No quarantine role is set (dashboard: Enforcement & appeals → Roles), or it no longer exists.
refuse.botNoManageRoles: Mewvo needs the Manage Roles permission to quarantine someone.
refuse.roleManaged: The quarantine role is managed by an integration, so Mewvo cannot give it.
refuse.roleAboveBot: The quarantine role is not below Mewvo's highest role, so Mewvo cannot give it.
refuse.owner: The server owner cannot be quarantined.
refuse.aboveBot: This member's highest role is not below Mewvo's highest role, so Mewvo cannot quarantine them.
refuse.notInServer: This member is not in the server.
refuse.database: The database is not responding, so nothing was changed.
refuse.assignFailed: Discord refused the role change, so nothing was changed.
refuse.failed: The quarantine did not work, so nothing was changed.
refuse.roleHasPermissions: The quarantine role has permissions of its own, so Mewvo will not use it (every quarantined member would get them). Give it no permissions.
refuse.aboveActor: This member's highest role is at or above yours.

release.adminOnly: Only Administrators can release someone from quarantine.
release.otherServer: This button only works in the staff server where the alert was posted.
release.none: This member is not quarantined any more.
release.offender: The staff guard acted on you recently, so you cannot use this button.
release.ownerOnly: The staff guard made this quarantine, so only the server owner can release it (like /staff restore).
release.tooHigh: Some of their saved roles are at or above your highest role ({roles}). Ask the server owner to release them.
release.left: They are no longer in the server. The quarantine record was removed, so a rejoin is not quarantined.
release.failed: Discord refused the role change, nothing was released: {error}
release.partial: The roles were given back, but the quarantine role or its record could not be removed. Press Release again: {error}

quarantine.ownerDm: They were quarantined: every role was saved and removed, and they can see no channel until someone presses Release on the alert (or you use /staff restore).

info.title: You are in quarantine
info.intro: Your access to **{server}** is paused. You can still read this channel, but you can't see or post in any other channel for now.
info.why: Our safety system or a staff member flagged your account, for example during a raid, for suspicious activity, or for breaking the rules. The reason was sent to you in a DM.
info.wait: Wait: staff review every quarantine and will either restore your access or explain the next steps.
info.talk: Talk to staff: join our support server {support} and tell them your username.
info.noAlts: Please don't create new accounts to get around the quarantine; that makes it permanent.
info.rolesSaved: Your roles were saved and will be given back if the quarantine is lifted.

decide.notDecider: Only the server owner and the roles set under “Who can decide on quarantined members” (Enforcement & appeals → Roles) can decide here.
decide.notMember: You are not a member of the server this quarantine is in.
decide.kickAsk: Kick {name}? They get a DM first, and a one-time invite to come back.

reply.keep: {name} stays in quarantine. Your review is noted on the alert.

decide.needsAdmin: This needs Administrator in the server the quarantine is in (Kick and Ban always do; a decider role needs it for every choice).
decide.recordNotCleared: The quarantine record could not be cleared (database); it is noted in the bot log.

joinUnknown.title: Quarantine state unknown
joinUnknown.text: {member} joined, but whether they are quarantined could not be checked (database not responding). They were given no roles; please check them.
